claim_classification_framework.description: Every key architectural claim MUST be tagged to prevent conflating evidence with requirements

PROVEN.meaning: Directly demonstrated by empirical findings in Issues #10-#13
PROVEN.example: The v0.2 EventStore loses in-memory state when the host process terminates

DERIVED.meaning: Logically follows from proven empirical evidence
DERIVED.example: Because v0.2 state is volatile, recovery after crash requires reading persisted events

REQUIREMENT.meaning: A v0.3 architectural rule/contract being imposed
REQUIREMENT.example: Causal ordering established by journal_position, not timestamp_ns

RESEARCH_QUESTION.example: Which persistence mechanism balances latency and durability?

DESIGN_DECISION.meaning: Normative constant assigned by this specification

usage_rules: PROVEN facts MUST NOT be stated as current guarantees of v0.3 behavior
REQUIREMENT rules MUST NOT be presented as empirically validated
RESEARCH_QUESTION items MUST NOT be treated as decided architecture
PROVISIONAL_REQUIREMENT targets MUST be validated or revised during Issues #14-#16

contract_authority.description: The Cortex Semantic Contract is the sole normative specification

conflict_resolution.if_python_differs_from_contract: Python has a bug OR contract is ambiguous
resolution_process: Update reference implementation AND/OR contract AND normative test vectors
Candidate runtimes MUST conform to contract, NOT to Python bugs

document_layering.description: Six-level structure preventing technology contamination of semantic contract

three_authorities_of_state.description: Three separate authorities governing recovery and side-effect classification

authorities.name: Semantic Authority
authorities.responsibility: Defines valid state transitions, invariants, lifecycle phases, protocol boundaries

authorities.name: Evidence Authority
authorities.responsibility: Provides immutable, ordered proof of emitted events and claim states

authorities.name: External-Effect Authority
authorities.component: External system / transactional API / payment gateway / idempotency registry
authorities.responsibility: Tracks actual mutations outside the Cortex boundary

classification_rules: RecoveryState MUST be determined solely from Evidence Authority (lifecycle events + claim table)
External-Effect Authority MUST NOT directly mutate RecoveryState
External proof MUST enter as ExternalProofAppended event in EventStore
Semantic Authority defines what each lifecycle phase means and which RecoveryState it implies

external_proof_integration.rule: External-Effect Authority data cannot mutate RecoveryState directly
external_proof_integration.mechanism: ExternalProofAppended event appended to EventStore; recovery classifier re-evaluates

resolution_transitions.note: Does NOT prove absence of original effect

architecture_hierarchy.description: Semantic contract is authoritative; Python is reference; candidates must conform

semantic_contract.description: Language-neutral behavioral contract — sole normative specification

Event.purpose: Immutable message carrying workflow correlation and causal lineage
invariants: Events MUST be immutable after creation
journal_position MUST be strictly monotonically increasing per workflow journal
If causation_id non-null, referenced event MUST exist AND journal_position(E) > journal_position(parent(E))
timestamp_ns MUST NOT be used for lineage verification or recovery classification

Command.purpose: Execution directive with explicit effect classification
invariants: Every command MUST declare explicit effect_class; EXTERNAL_SIDE_EFFECT MUST declare replay_property and recovery_property
Side effects MUST NOT be inferred from action name strings
required_capabilities MUST be validated before execution
Command execution MUST emit lifecycle events and exactly one terminal outcome
Commands MUST be executed at-most-once per command_id

CortexValue.purpose: Canonical language-neutral value model preventing type erasure across wire encodings

canonical_bytes_pipeline.authority: Cortex-CBE (Cortex Canonical Byte Encoding) — NOT RFC 8785/JCS
canonical_bytes_pipeline.invariant: Python(CortexValue) == Rust(CortexValue) == Go(CortexValue) at semantic and canonical byte level

dict.key_order: lexicographic by UTF-8 byte order of key canonical bytes

int.format: I + base-10 ASCII; zero is I0
int.rejection: Out of range or invalid format rejected at boundary

float.nan_infinity: NaN, +Inf, -Inf MUST BE REJECTED at boundary
float.subnormals: Encoded per exact IEEE 754 bit layout

string.length_definition: strictly UTF-8 byte count, NOT code points or grapheme clusters

dict_keys.ordering: Lexicographic by UTF-8 byte order of key canonical bytes

rules.type_distinction: 1 (I1), 1.0 (D3ff0000000000000), and "1" (S1:1) MUST produce distinct canonical bytes

CortexValue.wire_encoding_rule: Wire encodings MUST round-trip all CortexValue types without loss. map<string, string> is NOT a valid substitute for CortexValueMap.

command_property_taxonomy.description: Three orthogonal dimensions for side-effect semantics — not a single overloaded enum

ReplayProperty.note: Required for EXTERNAL_SIDE_EFFECT; NONE/default for PURE and READ_ONLY

RecoveryProperty.note: Required for EXTERNAL_SIDE_EFFECT; NONE/default for PURE and READ_ONLY

enforcement_rules: Runtime rejects EXTERNAL_SIDE_EFFECT commands missing idempotency_token with CAPABILITY_VIOLATION
Runtime MUST NOT infer any property dimension from action name patterns
COMPENSATABLE recovery does NOT make duplicate execution safe without token deduplication

CommandExecutionLifecycle.purpose: Explicit lifecycle transitions providing recovery evidence without external audit logs

phases.name: INTENT_RECORDED
phases.description: Command accepted and persisted in journal

phases.name: SIDE_EFFECT_COMMITTED
phases.description: External effect durably recorded; idempotency claim COMMITTED

in_doubt_epistemic_definition.meaning: Cortex cannot prove whether the external effect committed
critical_distinctions: IN_DOUBT does NOT assert the side effect happened
IN_DOUBT halts automated replay until operator or External-Effect Authority resolves

CommandExecutionLifecycle.critical_rule: Recovery classification MUST be determined solely from Evidence Authority (lifecycle events + idempotency claim table). External-Effect Authority MUST NOT be required classification input.

states.name: IN_DOUBT
states.description: Epistemic uncertainty: Cortex cannot prove whether external effect committed. IN_DOUBT != SIDE_EFFECT_COMMITTED

states.name: UNRECOVERABLE
states.description: Journal corrupted or causality chain broken

RecoveryState.removed_reason: Synonym for RECOVERABLE created state-machine ambiguity

RecoveryAction.purpose: Action to take given a RecoveryState — separate from state classification

IdempotencyToken.canonical_rule: Every EXTERNAL_SIDE_EFFECT command MUST carry explicit idempotency_token UUID on Command payload

operation_identity.definition: Canonical identity of the logical external operation
different_token_when: Different workflow_id OR causation_id OR command_type OR parameters

uuid_v5_derivation.requirement: Deterministic UUID v5 identical across all runtimes

namespace_uuid.note: [DESIGN DECISION] Reserved normative Cortex v0.3 system and idempotency namespaces

invariants: Consumers MUST use explicit idempotency_token field
Token provides duplicate detection; does NOT make non-idempotent operations inherently safe
Workflows MUST transition to FAILED if any VerificationResult has passed=false
CapabilitySet MUST be immutable after negotiation
Capability checks MUST occur before sensitive operations
Capability escalation post-negotiation MUST be impossible

journal_order.definition: Total linear persistence sequence via journal_position (int64)
journal_order.answers: In what sequence were events persisted?

causal_order.definition: Partial order from causation_id parent-child links

field_semantics.correlation_id: Workflow correlation group — NOT causal lineage
field_semantics.journal_position: Physical persistence order — NOT causal lineage

causal_order.graph_reconstruction: For each E with causation_id=P: add edge P→E; verify acyclic; verify journal_position ordering

three_tier_ordering.explicitly_forbidden: Conflating journal order, causal order, correlation grouping, or timestamp order

identity_domain_separation.purpose: Optional business/request key; MUST NOT mutate or replace logical_event_id or idempotency_token

ordering_mechanisms: journal_position: strictly monotonic int64 assigned by EventStore on append
causation_id: directed acyclic graph of parent-child event relationships
causal_lineage_rules.explicitly_forbidden: Using timestamp_ns for causal ordering, lineage verification, or recovery classification

dag_property.rule: For event E with causation_id = C: C exists, journal_position(E) > journal_position(C)

steps: Verify journal_position(parent) < journal_position(child) for all edges

recovery_state_machine.description: Evidence-based recovery using lifecycle phases — no external audit log dependency

forbidden_inputs: External-Effect Authority as automated classification input

steps.action: For each side-effect command, get last lifecycle phase and claim status

atomic_idempotency_claim_protocol.description: Concurrency-safe idempotency via atomic claim state machine

persistence_authority.claim_log: Durable claim state — NOT process RAM

atomicity_boundary.rule: Cortex transaction and external side effect CANNOT be atomically committed together unless external system participates in distributed transaction
atomicity_boundary.ambiguity_window: Crash between external execution and SIDE_EFFECT_COMMITTED produces IN_DOUBT

fencing_token.rule: Monotonically increasing per idempotency_token on each claim acquisition

semantic_invariants: Claim MUST have owner while IN_PROGRESS
fencing_token MUST monotonically increase on each claim acquisition for same idempotency_token
Any commit/write with fencing_token < current claim fencing_token MUST be rejected with STALE_FENCING_TOKEN
Expired lease alone MUST NOT authorize un-fenced re-execution
Stale worker resuming after lease expiry MUST NOT commit; stale fencing token writes rejected

claim_lease_ttl_ms.note: Configurable operational parameter — numeric value is NOT a semantic invariant

in_progress_recovery_paths.note: Requires new fencing_token; does NOT prove absence

transitions.operation: atomic claim (INSERT ON CONFLICT or CAS)

empirical_validation.description: Concurrent claim races and worker death during IN_PROGRESS

distinctions.name: EFFECT_CONFIRMED_ABSENT
distinctions.meaning: Verifiable proof the external effect did NOT occur
distinctions.evidence: External-Effect Authority lookup or idempotent query returning NOT_COMMITTED

distinctions.name: EFFECT_CONFIRMED_COMMITTED
distinctions.meaning: Verifiable proof the external effect DID occur

distinctions.name: RETRY_AUTHORIZED
distinctions.meaning: Operator/policy permits retry despite lingering ambiguity
distinctions.critical: RETRY_AUTHORIZED != EFFECT_CONFIRMED_ABSENT — does NOT prove absence of original effect

epistemic_recovery_taxonomy.in_doubt_invariant: IN_DOUBT does NOT imply failure; IN_DOUBT = epistemic uncertainty about external effect

scopes.name: REPLAY_COMPUTATION
scopes.description: Re-evaluate pure CPU/workflow logic up to uncommitted boundary
scopes.precondition: Last phase <= EXECUTION_STARTED for PURE/READ_ONLY, OR <= INTENT for unstarted side effects

scopes.name: REPLAY_COMPLETION
scopes.description: Synthesize completion events from durable evidence without re-executing mutations
scopes.precondition: External effect proven committed in Evidence or External-Effect Authority

scopes.name: RETRY_MUTATION
scopes.description: Re-issue external mutation with same idempotency_token and incremented fencing_token
scopes.must_not: Execute without idempotency token or fencing token

replay_scope_taxonomy.escalation_rule: Escalation to more dangerous scopes is NOT automatic

v02_reference_implementation.description: In-memory append-only journal; process death destroys all state
v02_reference_implementation.role: Reference for semantic behavior, NOT production durability

guarantees.description: Survives process crash — NOT a v0.2 property

evaluated_options.name: gRPC over UDS
evaluated_options.status: Primary Candidate / Baseline Recommendation — NOT adopted

rules: Reject session_epoch < current epoch for worker slot
Reject sequence_number <= last processed for (workflow_id, session_epoch)
replay_prevention.timestamp_only_rejection: Explicitly forbidden as sole replay protection

worker_death.corrected_behavior: Evidence-based classification per Section 4 — NOT blanket IN_DOUBT
response_steps: For each in-flight command: classify_recovery(workflow_id, event_log, claims)
worker_death.forbidden: Immediately marking all in-flight commands as IN_DOUBT on worker death

response_steps: Classify all workflows per lifecycle evidence algorithm
Auto-resume RECOVERABLE; flag IN_DOUBT for operator

conformance_verification_framework.description: Normative vectors + property-based testing — NOT merely static vector pass rate

100_percent_conformance_means: 100% pass on normative test vector suite
Property-based / state-machine tests: invariants hold under generative crash injection and concurrent claim races
definition.100_percent_conformance_does_not_mean: Passing N/N vectors proves equivalence over all possible behaviors — only conformance to defined normative suite

semantic_projection.name: P_semantic
semantic_projection.definition: Deterministic projection stripping ephemeral runtime fields for parity comparison

test_categories.pass_criteria: All invariants hold under crash/concurrency injection

performance_metrics.note: Performance evaluated independently; thresholds pending benchmark validation

contract_authority.decision: Semantic Contract authoritative; Python is reference

causal_ordering.decision: journal_position + causation DAG; timestamp_ns observational only

recovery_evidence.decision: Command lifecycle phases; no external audit log dependency

effect_classes.decision: Three orthogonal dimensions: EffectClass + ReplayProperty + RecoveryProperty

three_authorities.decision: Semantic, Evidence, External-Effect authorities with strict separation

value_model.decision: CortexValue tagged union with Cortex-CBE canonical byte encoding (NOT JCS)

fencing_tokens.decision: Monotonic 64-bit fencing_token on claims; stale token commits rejected

replay_scopes.decision: REPLAY_COMPUTATION, REPLAY_COMPLETION, RETRY_MUTATION with distinct preconditions

phase_3_v040.description: Production polyglot deployment per validated assignments

non_negotiable_constraints: All 172 canonical unit tests MUST pass without modification
git diff pyproject.toml uv.lock cortex/ tests/ MUST return empty

independent_validation_appendix.method: Python 3 standard library only (uuid, struct, hashlib) — no Cortex imports
